clauses.text:
Executive Order 12120 of February 14, 1979
The Honorable Adolph Dubs
As a special mark of respect to the memory of the Honorable Adolph Dubs, 
Ambassador of the United States of America to Afghanistan, killed while in 
the performance of his duty, it is hereby ordered, pursuant to the provisions of 
36 U.S.C. 175(m), that on the day of interment, the flag of the United States 
shall be flown at half-staff on all buildings, grounds, and naval vessels of the 
Federal government in the District of Columbia and throughout the United 
States and its territories and possessions. I also direct that the flag shall be 
flown at half-staff on the same day at all United States embassies, consular 
offices, and other facilities abroad, including all military facilities and naval 
vessels and stations.
